Name: Build and Place Anything Anywhere
Author: FearGodFishFish
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/installation.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [b][code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][/b]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/how-to-use.png[/img]
Press the [b]Comma[/b] or [b]Period[/b] keys to open up the carpenter or wizard build menus. Select where you want to start building and done!
For placing furniture/objects, simply place it down where you want.

If you want to build or place in a disallowed spot, open the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and enable [b]Build Anywhere[/b] or [b]Place Anywhere[/b] respectively.

Hold the [b]Left Shift[/b] key while building to build/upgrade/destroy more than one building without getting kicked out of the menu.

To upgrade or renovate cabins, build a cabin then upgrade in Robins menu. This is a feature for the main player only.

All the "cheating" options are disabled by default so make sure you look through the config and enable what you want/need!
[size=4]
[url=https://github.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/blob/main/README.md][OUTDATED]Click here for a full list with descriptions of all the config options![/url][/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/frequently-asked-questions.png[/img]﻿
[b]Can I uninstall without issue?[/b]
[list][*]Yes, any buildings built outside of the farm map will still function as well.
[/list][b]I clicked hide location but its still showing up in Robins menu
[/b][list][*]Reload your save and that should reset the locations.
[/list][b]Can you build greenhouses with this mod?[/b][list][*]Yes, you can build the greenhouse as long as you have the greenhouse unlocked. This can be disabled in the settings.
[/list][b]Do greenhouses build with this mod work with custom greenhouse interior mods
[/b][list]
[*]Yes, they work just fine.
[/list][b]Can I move buildings or animals to another map?[/b]
[list]
[*]Yes, you can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20606]Relocate Buildings And Farm Animals[/url]﻿ mod to do this.
[/list][b]Does this work with casks as well?[/b]
[list][*]Yes, you can enable placing casks as well by turning on the "Cask Functionality" toggle in the "Misc" category.
[/list][b]Can fruit trees be planted right next to each other?[/b]
[list][*]Yes, the "Fruit Tree Tweaks" toggle in the "Farming" category will remove fruit tree growth restrictions. 
[*]If placed next to each other with the "Place Anywhere" toggle they will still have the growth restrictions.
[/list][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/compatibility.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.8 or later.
[*]Singleplayer and Multiplayer (even if other players don’t have it).
[*]Mods that add new blueprints
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia[/url] bushes and trees now work
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18444?tab=bugs]Flip Buildings[/url]﻿ works with the custom menu
[/list][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/mod-conflicts.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Alternative Textures: both mods will work fine, but you can’t change the skins of buildings outside of the farm.
[*]Better Junimos: Doesn't work outside of the farm and will spam harmless errors when opening the wizard build menu.
[/list][img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smoked-Fish/AnythingAnywhere/main/images/current-limitations.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Jukebox still won’t work in the rain.
[*]Can't move buildings from one map to another

Downloads.Description:
Added a dedicated Cabin Menu button and debug commands
Added a toggle to make trees show seasonal sprites while still producing fruit
Cabins owned by players will make sure that player is offline
Greenhouse disabled by default.
Check changelog for more
